coverage_limits: I could not enlarge or crop beyond the supplied image thirds, so fine pointing (meteg, dagesh, qamats vs. patah, sheva vs. hataf) in the Hebrew pages is often not certifiable. Those cases are listed as unresolved, not corrected. The consonant-level findings on s134, s136, s138 and s140 are substantial: the s134 Adderet fragment and several Shabbat stanzas differ from the print in whole words. These pages should not be accepted until corrected and re-verified. I treated the human-settled אַאֽפִּיר reading and the Metz Kol scope as authoritative and only noted the visual appearance of the aafir final letter. Running heads and the signature mark IV · 8 were treated as print furniture. source_typo_corrections is empty, so none of the findings above are flagged as original-print sic/corr.
